# HANDOVER — superseded; see `/CLAUDE.md`

**This file is a pointer, not a document. Do not work from it, and do not edit it.**

The project's working protocol — who you are working with, the documents, the decisions in force, the current state, and the baby-step rules — lives in **`CLAUDE.md` in the repository root**, which Claude Code loads automatically at the start of every session. `CLAUDE.md` is the single source of truth for the protocol.

## Why this file still exists

Until 7 August 2026 this *was* the live handover document. BUILD_PLAN Step 13 duplicated it as `CLAUDE.md` so that the protocol would load automatically rather than depending on someone remembering to paste it. The copy is what stayed current; this original was never updated again, and by 9 August it had drifted badly — pre-Step-13 paths that no longer exist, and "nine agreed decisions, D1–D9" when there are twelve.

It was reduced to a pointer on **9 August 2026** rather than re-synchronised, deliberately. Two editable copies of the working protocol is the same hazard `memory/SETUP_LOG.md` records for the planning documents: it is exactly how two machines end up silently working from different versions. The file is kept only because earlier journal entries and BUILD_PLAN Step 13 refer to it by name, and those are historical records that are never rewritten.
